notes.title: New Features & 2023 Recap
notes.notes:
[b]Happy New Year 2024![/b]

First of all thank you for trying out the Prologue and providing amazing feedback. Your reviews and messages helped us improve the game as we finish the development.

[h1]New Features[/h1]
Much requested feature of mini-map widget is now available in the top right corner to help navigate the world. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40281659/4bf13644ddbf6c453645ddeb8f89ee55b55cb418.png[/img]

New crafting table to help make herbal remedies and yummy Indian pickles. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40281659/01c5e1a5b22ddcd41e08fae1791a1a3623f8590f.jpg[/img]

Now you can take a nap till teatime or skip time to sleep through the night.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40281659/5aa95a0eb2db11bc1a2ad5056237345557498a73.jpg[/img]

[h1]2023 Recap[/h1]
It has been a wonderful year for us. Starting with the feature in [url=https://www.ludonarracon.com/]LudoNarraCon [/url]and then in [url=https://wholesomegames.com/]Wholesome Direct[/url], the game was discovered by thousands of new players.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40281659/5feff172bf8be1a4d06e37c04d6fd3db732e00ea.png[/img]
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40281659/e532c2112744c7cde27f9504b5eb196d7b31691b.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40281659/89ee3de8a79f2b0292fdd08a40bed4e1143f3cec.png[/img][/url]

Towards mid 2023, we got selected for the prestigious [url=https://www.xbox.com/en-IN/games/id]Microsoft Xbox IDAP[/url] which provided financial assistance for development and porting the game to Xbox consoles.
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40281659/45e23b30b07e2db112533dab54b81662c733a5d4.jpg][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40281659/188f15f2da417e6c4c8eeaec329bf8d6ac097158.jpg[/img][/url]

Soon after the team got selected to participate in [url=https://wingsfund.me/elevate/]Wings Elevate[/url] program sponsored by Netflix. This program provided wonderful mentorship opportunities as well as financial assistance for development.
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40281659/3bd85ebabbf2dcce48292809d06815dace6feecf.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40281659/089900e7777f9883cd8fb3190f7ea2f7051114f3.png[/img][/url]

[h1]Looking Forward[/h1]
Development of the full game is going on and is about to hit the finish line soon™. New release trailer is  ready but you'll need to wait for a release date announcement before we can show it.
Join us on our [url=https://discord.gg/4QwKy2bN35]Discord[/url] to follow the project and help us make the game better!

notes.title: The Palace on the Hill Stream
notes.notes:
We are so excited to be featured on LudoNarraCon from 4-8 May.  Join Yadu Rajiv, founder of gamedev.in as he plays the just released prologue of The Palace on the Hill.

The game is an adventure-management game about a boy from 90s rural India and his struggles to go to college. 
Filled with activities like making art, growing vegetables, managing a tea shop and running errands for quirky NPCs, the game gives you a relaxing slice-of-life village experience with an uplifting story.
Hope you enjoy and please do try it out for yourself.

You can keep up with the developers on [url=https://twitter.com/palaceonhill]Twitter[/url] and [url=https://discord.gg/4QwKy2bN35]Discord[/url].

Do check out the other wonderful games participating in LudoNarraCon. 

Cheers and love from Niku Games.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40281659/87f2b6c05260353a82baa82a928858e056e641cb.jpg[/img]
